Usage: memoriahub convert [options] [path...]

Convert video files (MOV, MTS, AVI, WMV, …) to MP4 (requires ffmpeg)

Arguments:
  path                       Video files and/or folders to convert (omit to use
                             --all)

Options:
  --all                      Convert videos in all registered enabled folders
                             (default: false)
  --dry-run                  Preview what would be converted without running
                             ffmpeg (default: false)
  -r, --recursive            Descend into sub-directories (when auto-registering
                             a folder) (default: false)
  --concurrency <n>          Number of concurrent conversions
  --formats <list>           Comma-separated extensions to convert (default: all
                             non-MP4 videos)
  --keep-originals           Keep each source file alongside the new MP4
                             (default) (default: false)
  --delete-original          Delete each source file after its MP4 is written
                             (default: false)
  --move-originals-to <dir>  Move each source file into <dir> after its MP4 is
                             written
  --overwrite                Overwrite an existing target .mp4 instead of
                             skipping it (default: false)
  --reencode                 Force a full H.264 re-encode (skip the lossless
                             remux fast-path) (default: false)
  --crf <n>                  Quality for re-encode (lower = better, default 20)
  --json                     Emit the summary as JSON instead of a table
                             (default: false)
  -h, --help                 display help for command
